tools.name: encharge_get_account
tools.description: The Encharge account behind the API key: account id, name, site, status, timezone, people count and active services. GET /accounts/info.

tools.name: encharge_get_people
tools.description: Look up people (contacts) by email, userId or Encharge id. Pass up to 20 people, each with at least one identifier. Returns each person with all fields, tags and segment data; a person that does not exist is left out. GET /people.

tools.name: encharge_list_segment_people
tools.description: People in one dynamic segment, with paging (limit/offset), optional sort and a choice of person fields (attributes). Use encharge_list_segments for segment ids and encharge_list_fields for field names. GET /segments/{segmentId}/people.

tools.name: encharge_upsert_person
tools.description: WRITE: create a person, or update the one that already has this email, userId or Encharge id. Only the fields you pass are set. Use encharge_add_tags for tags. POST /people.

tools.name: encharge_unsubscribe_person
tools.description: WRITE: unsubscribe one person so Encharge sends them no more email. The person stays in Encharge. Identify them by email, userId or Encharge id. POST /people/unsubscribe.

tools.name: encharge_add_tags
tools.description: WRITE: add one or more tags to an existing person. Tags that do not exist yet are created. POST /tags.

tools.name: encharge_remove_tags
tools.description: WRITE: remove one or more tags from an existing person. The tags themselves are not deleted. DELETE /tags.

tools.name: encharge_list_segments
tools.description: List the dynamic segments of the account with id, name and conditions. Use the ids with encharge_list_segment_people. GET /segments.

tools.name: encharge_list_fields
tools.description: List all person fields (built-in and custom) with name, title, type and whether the field is read-only. Use the names in encharge_upsert_person. GET /fields.

tools.name: encharge_track_event
tools.description: WRITE: record an event for a person through the Ingest API, for example "Registered user" or "Created Page". The person is created or updated from `user`. Use the event name "identify" to only create or update a person. Needs the account write key. POST https://ingest.encharge.io/v1/.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: encharge_get_people · Private data: encharge_get_account, encharge_get_people, encharge_track_event · Public sink: encharge_get_people, encharge_upsert_person, encharge_unsubscribe_person, encharge_add_tags, encharge_track_event · Destructive: encharge_remove_tags.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: encharge_get_people · Private data: encharge_get_account, encharge_get_people, encharge_track_event · Public sink: encharge_get_people, encharge_upsert_person, encharge_unsubscribe_person, encharge_add_tags, encharge_track_event · Destructive: encharge_remove_tags

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
